symptom: v53 temporary probes using the new player_forward_lane spawn_hazard placement did not produce a promotable content repair. Probe A kept RouteBot at 40.0% while pushing TankBot and ZoneControlBot to 20.0%. Probe B also kept RouteBot at 40.0% while pushing GreedyXpBot, TankBot, and ZoneControlBot to 20.0%.
root_cause: A forward-lane hazard placed at Boss entry acts as broad path pressure rather than a fixed-route-specific correction. It affects normal tank, control, and XP-seeking policies that also pass through or recover through the Boss-entry lane, while the remaining RouteBot winning seeds can still survive or recover after the event.
fix: Do not promote v53 probes to generated_candidate_patches, generated_candidates, simulated_candidates, playtest_candidates, accepted_content, or Runtime content. Keep the GameCore forward-lane placement as a general content capability, but stop using it as the immediate frosting-grassland RouteBot repair. Next repair should first export 200-240 second RouteBot winning and failing trajectories, then design a more specific repeated-route or seed-state intervention.
